_comment: FIX134 — the default config (npm start, and what `npm run dist` with no --config ships beside the exe): the local stack served over https by the Caddy front door (docs/ops/tls.md) — same ports as before FIX133, https scheme, and this machine's local CA pinned for these hosts (trustedCaFile, relative to this file: infra/caddy/certs/rootCA.pem, gitignored, one per machine — the validator refuses to start or build without it, so make it first (mkcert, docs/ops/tls.md); scripts/dist.js ships it as resources/trusted-ca.pem). For a stack without Caddy use desktop.config.plain-http.json. Origin values are configuration, never constants (E1 §2). allowedOrigins are exact scheme://host[:port] origins — no wildcards, no paths. pageUrl must be inside allowedOrigins. portalOrigin is deliberately NOT in allowedOrigins: a navigation towards it is the re-auth signal, refused here and answered host-side (E2). gatewayUrl is the identity authority (refresh / ticket exchange / logout / agent key / turns / web_search) and the host of the injected session cookies; chatEdgeUrl is the page's conversation store (history, transcript import, rename, memories, run_python). Neither is allow-listed for navigation. protocolScheme is the app's deep-link scheme — sran:// (FIX34 Part B, owner decision; the retired WPF shell no longer holds it) — and oauthClient must be the backend client id that maps to it (desktop ↔ sran, desktop-dev ↔ sran-dev). App links follow Claude's shape: sran://<web host>/new[?q=…|?file=…], /chat/{id}, /project/{id}; q is prefilled, never sent. sessionRefreshMinutes must stay under the 60-minute portal access TTL (E2 §4). sidecarPath is the tools sidecar exe (E4), relative to the app root or absolute; approvalMode is the WPF app's manual|auto|skip; webSearchEnabled lists web_search only when true (WPF default: off). temporaryChatReadsMemory (FIX56.1) is retired (FIX130): a memory-off or temporary chat neither reads nor writes memory, and an old value of the key is ignored. Override the whole file with SRAN_DESKTOP_CONFIG (absolute path). connectorPrivateNetwork (FIX69) is whether a user-typed remote MCP connector URL may point inside the network (loopback / RFC 1918 / link-local); default false = public https targets only; cloud metadata addresses are refused regardless. Set true only for a build meant for a company network.
